meta.name: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural
meta.description: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural is a supernatural family sitcom and the Indian adaptation of Bewitched. Urvashi, a chudail longing for a human family, marries Aarav Patel and joins his lively Gujarati joint family. As her magic causes hilarious mishaps, Aarav struggles to protect her secret while her human-hating mother Kamini fuels the chaos. Amid magical mayhem, and family drama, love finds a way.

videos.title: E1. The Bride's Secret
videos.overview: When a chudail becomes the newest bahu of a Gujarati joint family, her hidden powers turn everyday life into an unexpected adventure.

videos.title: E2. My Wife Is A Witch
videos.overview: A forgotten truth spell turns Aarav brutally honest, but chaos erupts when he accidentally reveals Urvashi's biggest secret to the entire family.

videos.title: E3. The Truth Spell Chaos
videos.overview: Aarav's truth spell throws the Patel family into disarray as hidden truths come to light. As tensions rise and secrets are exposed, Urvashi finds herself in an increasingly difficult situation.

videos.title: E4. The Great Family Split
videos.overview: A misunderstanding sparks a family feud, dividing the Patel household into two camps. As tempers flare and loyalties are tested, Aarav and Urvashi look for a way to restore peace.

videos.title: E5. A Love Story Revisited
videos.overview: With the family divided and tensions running high, Aarav and Urvashi attempt to mend relationships by helping Vimla and Narottam relive a special memory from their past, hoping old feelings can heal present conflicts.

videos.title: E6. Love, Apologies And New Troubles
videos.overview: With the family finally reunited, peace returns to the household. But just as things settle down, Aarav's growing focus on work creates fresh trouble for Urvashi.

videos.title: E7. The Two Sides Of Aarav
videos.overview: Urvashi's magic splits Aarav's priorities in an unexpected way. What begins as a solution soon turns into a fresh challenge as the family struggles to deal with the consequences.

videos.title: E8. A Spell Gone Wrong
videos.overview: Urvashi casts a spell on Aarav, making him strict at work and gentle at home. Alarmed by the chaos, she turns to her mother for help.

videos.title: E9. A Gentleman At Home
videos.overview: Aarav returns home transformed into a caring family man by Urvashi's magic. As his kindness wins hearts, happiness fills the home.
